about: Fernanfloo Dresses Up puts two photos of the Salvadoran YouTuber Fernanfloo side by side under a white strip for captions. On the left he stands in a gray hoodie and blue plaid pajama pants with a goofy grin; on the right he poses in a sharp black suit, white shirt and black tie with a confident smile. The pair shows the same person putting in minimum effort and maximum effort, so captions compare how someone treats two occasions: the ordinary one gets the pajamas and the unexpectedly important one gets the full suit. The bigger the mismatch between the occasion and the effort, the better.
origin: Fernanfloo, one of the biggest Spanish-language YouTubers, posted the suit photo on Instagram in 2019. Paired with a casual pajama photo of him, it became a popular comparison meme in Spanish and then English communities.
usage:
The first box goes above the pajama photo: the situation that gets no effort. The second box goes above the suit photo: the situation where you suddenly dress up. The classic twist is choosing something serious for the pajamas and something silly for the suit, like "my job interview" versus "a new game release".

It also works straight, as a before-and-after of trying harder, or for camera-on versus camera-off video calls. Keep both captions parallel ("me at..." / "me at...") so the contrast is instant.
ideas: me on a regular zoom call
me when the camera is on
me at the midnight game launch
